title: iris pumila var. binata
intro: Iris pumila var. binata, commonly known as Dwarf Crested Iris or Creeping Iris, is a type of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant is known for its ability to help alleviate stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its health benefits, which include promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Iris pumila var. binata are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help reduce anxiety and promote a sense of calm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
